newsitem.title: USA: American Brands holders approve proposals.
newsitem.headline: American Brands holders approve proposals.

text.p: American Brands Inc said Wednesday that stockholders approved the spin-off of its U.K.-based Gallaher tobacco business and the change of its name to Fortune Brands Inc at its Annual Meeting.
The spin-off is subject to receipt of a ruling from the Internal Revenue Service that the spin-off would qualify as a tax-free transaction to U.S. stockholders.
American Brands also said its board of directors set a May 30, 1997 record and payment date for the spin-off and the name change, assuming timely receipt of the IRS ruling.
Under the current timetable, on June 2 Fortune Brands will begin trading under the symbol "FO," and Gallaher ADRs, under the symbol "GLH" on the New York Stock Exchange.
